description:
Integrate WorkManager into the WeatherApp project to perform periodic background data synchronization.

1. Add the dependency `androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx:2.9.1` (or newer) to the app's `build.gradle.kts`.
2. Create a new file `app/src/main/java/com/example/weatherapp/sync/SyncWorker.kt`. The `SyncWorker` class must:
   - Extend `CoroutineWorker`.
   - In `doWork()`, save the current system time (milliseconds) to SharedPreferences using the name "weather_prefs" and key "last_sync_time".
   - Return `Result.success()`.
3. Create or update the `Application` class at `app/src/main/java/com/example/weatherapp/WeatherApplication.kt`:
   - Extend `android.app.Application`.
   - In `onCreate()`, schedule a PeriodicWorkRequest for `SyncWorker` that runs every 15 minutes.
   - Add a constraint requiring `NetworkType.CONNECTED`.
   - Enqueue it using `enqueueUniquePeriodicWork` with the name "weather_sync" and policy `KEEP`.
4. Register `WeatherApplication` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
5. Verify the project builds successfully.
